summary: Redesign processes, roles, governance, and KPIs for AI at scale. Build an executive transformation blueprint. Explore the course.
lede: AI operating model transformation training helps senior leaders connect AI use cases to redesigned workflows, roles, governance, and performance measures. For executives and senior functional leaders, it develops practical skills in prioritizing processes, mapping value streams, aligning roles and skills, designing human-agent workflows, and selecting operational KPIs to shape a sequenced transformation blueprint.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for executives and senior functional leaders who sponsor AI adoption and need to align processes, workforce design, governance, and performance measures across the organization.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
modules: AI Governance with NIST AI RMF
prerequisites: Designed for senior leaders with responsibility for strategy, operations, workforce, transformation, or AI governance. Prior AI implementation experience is useful but not required; familiarity with organizational processes and performance measures will help. Coding or programming is not required. Exercises focus on operating model decisions and executive-level design, not technical AI development.
